obligations.target: Verify the badge PDF generator endpoint/view renders the form with input fields for badge records and interactive layout/formatting options for a valid active event identifier.
obligations.reason: Ensures the server route and template handle valid event IDs and produce the badge generation form HTML with record inputs and configuration controls.

obligations.target: Navigate to the badge PDF generator page for an active event and verify the form, input controls, and interactive layout/formatting controls are visible and accessible in the browser.
obligations.reason: Validates end-to-end browser rendering and accessibility of interactive controls on the badge PDF generator page as required by the thorough verification policy.

obligations.target: Verify that requesting the badge PDF generator with a non-existent event identifier returns an error notification and suppresses the badge form.
obligations.reason: Tests backend route logic for handling non-existent events, returning appropriate error response and preventing form display.

obligations.target: Navigate to the badge generator URL with an unknown event ID and verify the browser displays the not-found error message and does not render the generation form.
obligations.reason: Provides end-to-end browser verification that invalid event parameters result in user-visible error notifications without exposing the generation form.

obligations.target: Verify PDF generation service/endpoint accepts valid badge recipient data with default options and generates a valid PDF document containing the submitted data.
obligations.reason: Isolates the PDF document compilation and generator logic to guarantee valid PDF binary output containing the recipient information.

obligations.target: Submit valid badge recipient data with default options on the form and verify successful PDF document generation and download in the browser.
obligations.reason: Validates the critical end-to-end flow from form interaction and submission to successful PDF delivery in a real browser session.

obligations.target: Verify the PDF generation logic correctly incorporates custom options (layout, dimensions, style) into the generated PDF output.
obligations.reason: Proves backend PDF styling, layout, and dimension parameters are properly parsed and applied during document synthesis.

obligations.target: Configure custom layout, print dimensions, and style options on the form, submit with valid recipient data, and verify the generated PDF reflects the options.
obligations.reason: Ensures browser form controls properly pass custom configuration options through submission and yield the customized PDF output.

obligations.target: Verify validation logic rejects submissions missing required badge data, returns the appropriate error message, and does not produce a PDF.
obligations.reason: Tests input validation and error handling logic in isolation to ensure missing required data prevents document generation.

obligations.target: Submit the badge form without entering required badge data and verify the browser shows the missing data validation error without triggering PDF generation.
obligations.reason: Validates user interface feedback and submission prevention in the browser when required badge fields are omitted.

obligations.target: Verify the parser and validation handlers reject malformed/unparseable badge data, display an invalid format message, and prevent PDF generation.
obligations.reason: Tests data parsing rules and error handling routines when bad or unparseable input structures are submitted.

obligations.target: Enter malformed/unparseable badge data into the form, submit, and verify in the browser that the validation error is shown and no PDF document is generated.
obligations.reason: Ensures the user interface gracefully handles malformed data inputs, surfaces appropriate error feedback, and aborts generation.
